hints.title: Three Category Partition
hints.text: Elements fall into three ordered groups: strictly less than pivot, equal to pivot, and strictly greater than pivot.

hints.title: Preserve Relative Order
hints.text: Iterate through nums to collect elements for each group in their original order.

hints.title: Concatenate Buckets
hints.text: Concatenate the three collected groups to produce the final partitioned array.

hints.title: Complete Python Solution
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def pivotArray(self, nums: List[int], pivot: int) -> List[int]:
        less = [x for x in nums if x < pivot]
        equal = [x for x in nums if x == pivot]
        greater = [x for x in nums if x > pivot]
        return less + equal + greater
```

complexity.whyNaiveFails: In-place quicksort partitioning does not preserve relative stable order without extra shifts.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Filtering into three auxiliary lists guarantees linear stability.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Preserve relative order across all three buckets in O(N) time.

solutions.approach: Java single array filling in three passes.
